newsitem.title: CHINA: China welcomes choice of U.N. secretary-general.
newsitem.headline: China welcomes choice of U.N. secretary-general.

text.p: China said on Saturday it welcomed the choice of Kofi Annan from Ghana as the next U.N. secretary-general and congratulated African nations on the selection.

"The result of the Security Council consultations conforms to the consistent position of China and is what China hopes to see," Xinhua quoted Qin Huasun, China's ambassador to the United Nations, as saying.
"On the question of electing the secretary-general, China has always been supporting the claim of African countries for a second term of U.N. secretary-general," Qin said.
Kofi Annan, undersecretary-general for peace-keeping operations, was chosen by the U.N. Security Council on Friday to be the next secretary-general.
All 15 Security Council members backed the selection of Annan, 58, after France dropped a veto threat. The choice now goes to the 185-nation General Assembly, which is to appoint him on Tuesday.
He will succeed Egypt's Boutros Boutros-Ghali, who sought a second five-year term but was blocked by the United States.
